instruction: You are the order fulfillment manager for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-005 (Stop supply for a duplicated customer release). Prove that the EDI release duplicates an existing order and cancel only the unconsumed purchase commitment created for the duplicate. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, send the scoped completion email; then write the outcome into the existing control-workbook cell. Return exactly: order_number, supply_action, revised_commit_date.
